name: SSOP (Sanitation Standard Operating Procedure)
search_intent: Quality assurance managers, kitchen hygiene supervisors, and food processors seeking an operational Sanitation Standard Operating Procedure (SSOP) covering machinery lock-out, gross debris scraping, detergent wash, BS EN 1276 chemical contact times, and ATP swab line clearance (<30 RLU).

competitors.name: Safe Food Alliance
competitors.features: Detailed industry guide with static printable PDF and training course offerings.

competitors.name: SafetyCulture
competitors.features: Digital inspection app requiring login and paid subscription.

competitors.name: FSIS USDA / FSA UK
competitors.features: Dense regulatory text explaining statutory compliance without interactive tickboxes.

competitors.name: FoodDocs
competitors.features: Automated food safety software lead magnet requiring email registration.

competitors.name: 3M Food Safety
competitors.features: ATP hygiene monitoring technical article promoting luminometer hardware.

gap_analysis.competitor_weaknesses: Dense regulatory manuals or expensive enterprise SaaS tools; lack of interactive browser-based verification checklists with built-in BS EN 1276 chemical contact timers and ATP swab tracking.
our_differentiators: 100% free interactive digital tool with instant browser state saving
Built-in 30-second to 5-minute BS EN 1276 chemical sanitiser stopwatch
ATP bioluminescence pass/fail tracking (<30 RLU benchmark)
One-click A4 print layout and CSV export for EHO/BRCGS audits
